description:
FILED s473t6a (Opus, 2026-09-17) by #1501 ROUND 8 (t6a), while classifying the
companion op/ leg after #1813 shipped.  EXPOSED, NOT CAUSED, by #1813.

THE FACT (perl 5.40.3, probed both ways):
  a COMPOUND assignment's VALUE is its LEFT OPERAND AS AN LVALUE, so whoever
  consumes that value READS the variable again -- which for a tied scalar is a
  second FETCH.  A PLAIN assignment's value is the value stored, and reads
  nothing again.

    tie my $x, "main", 1;  tie my $y, "main", 3;   # FETCH counters
    $x |= $y;                # VOID:  perl fetches($x) == 1   PCL == 1   OK
    my $a = ($x |= $y);      # VALUE: perl fetches($x) == 2   PCL == 1   WRONG
    my $c = ($x  = 5);       # plain: perl fetches($x) == 1   PCL == 1   OK

  Same for every OP= measured: |= &= ^= += .= -- perl 2, PCL 1.  (Before
  #1813, PCL answered 2 for the BITWISE trio by accident, because every
  bitwise op read its operand twice; the same accident made the VOID count 2,
  which perl says is 1.  `+=` and `.=` answered 1 in both contexts on main,
  i.e. this gap is OLDER than #1813 and #1813 merely made it uniform.)
  The probe is scratch/s473t6a/probes2/p1.pl + p2.pl in the round's archive.

ROWS BEHIND IT: nine, all in t/op/bop.t's "double magic tests" block --
  test 65/70/75 (lines 179/185/191, the numeric block), 98/103/108
  (221/227/233, the `use integer` block) and 131/136/141 (268/274/280, the
  string block), each `is(fetches($x), 2)` right after a compound |= &= ^=.
  They are in baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv with this number.  The same
  block's other 14 rows were FIXED by #1813, so op/bop.t is a net 469/28 ->
  474/23 and perl-tests/bop.t a net 480/29 -> 485/24.

WHY IT WAS NOT FIXED IN t6a: the fix needs the compound-assign macros to
  return the PLACE rather than the computed value, and that is a semantic
  change to every consumer of an `OP=` expression (aliasing, list context,
  the raw-slot twins) -- a new mechanism, outside the round's bound.  Two
  shapes to weigh:
    (a) RETURN THE PLACE from %define-compound-pair's boxed macro (the raw
        twin keeps returning the value -- a raw slot has no magic to re-read).
        Matches perl in BOTH contexts with no emitter change; the risk is that
        a consumer now aliases the box instead of copying it, so `my @a =
        ($x += 1)` and every p-flatten-args path must be probed.
    (b) Teach the emitter void-vs-value context for a compound assignment and
        emit a re-read only in value context.  No aliasing risk, but it is a
        new emission distinction.
  Measure (a) first: it is ~5 lines and the sweep + the op/ companion leg say
  immediately whether anything aliases.

DO NOT RETRY: "make p-bit-or= read the place twice" -- that restores the VOID
  count to 2, which perl says is 1, and t6a probed it.
subject: A compound assignment OP= returns its LEFT OPERAND AS AN LVALUE, so consuming its value re-FETCHes a tied scalar: perl 2 fetches, PCL 1 (9 rows in t/op/bop.t)
